title: Can I BEAT Gambonanza?
summary: Gambonanza: a chess roguelike on a mini board (iwantcheckmate plays the game). A run starts with a piece-wheel spin (Tony gets two kings and a rook) and $5. Five stages of five games each, the fifth game a boss: stage 1 on a 5x5 board (two pawns; five pawns; four pawns and a knight; three pawns and two rooks; boss Judit Polgeisha, the queen of illusions: skull king + two bishops, hides the enemy formation, squares disappear), stage 2 on a 6x5 board (crumbler pieces that make a random tile crumble on every capture, a copycat that copies itself when you wait, boss M3CH4GNUS C4RLS3N who shuffles your formation and makes it unreadable), stage 3 opens with Hikaru the banished (no stock during the game, a skull queen). Before every game you arrange your pieces on your two home rows ('Prepare your strategy!', GO!!). It is a capture-all variant: no check, kings are ordinary pieces, a side that can't move passes, and you have 3 Waits per game. Wins pay a win reward + $1 per captured piece + interest ($1 per $10, max 5). Between games a shop sells one piece (queen $10, king $3, pawn $2), +1 max pieces on the board ($10, ... $20), re-rolls ($2), tokens (choose one among N pieces / modified tiles / gambits) and gambits (Church's, Will-o'-the-Wisp's, Survivor's, Shadow's, Musketeers', Philosopher's Stone, Limited Edition's, Family's, Backup's, Stock Clearance's, Oshaya's, Black Stallion's and several read without a name). Tony beats both bosses, loses one game (retried with the same army) and his run ends in stage 3 game 1 when a knight steps off a falling tile just before it falls.
rules: Run start: piece wheel gives the starting army (video: two kings and a rook); bank starts at $5 (0:42 still).
Five stages x five games; game 5 of each stage is a boss with a drawback card ('Incoming Boss').
Formation phase before every game: place / move / bench your pieces on your two home rows (the middle row and the enemy rows are hatched off), then GO!!. Pieces n/max shown.
Capture-all: no check or checkmate, kings are ordinary pieces; capture every enemy piece to win. A side with no legal move passes (4:12 'Can't play... moves back to my turn').
Wait button: pass your turn, 3 per game ('Wait 3/3').
Stock: pieces beyond the max-on-board wait in the stock and can be landed on your home rows during the game, costing a turn (Hikaru the banished forbids it).
Skull pieces can only be captured last; any piece standing on a tile when it falls is lost (a piece may step off in time).
Crumbler enemy: while it is on the board every capture makes a random tile crumble. Copycat enemy: when you wait it copies itself onto a random tile.
Money after a win: win reward + $1 per captured piece + interest $1 per $10 (max 5) + gambit bonuses.

Shop between games: one piece offer (queen $10, king $3, pawn $2; more with Stock Clearance's), +1 max pieces ($10 first, $20 for the third), re-roll $2, chess/tile/gambit tokens, two gambits; pieces and gambits can be sold.
Losing a game: the first loss was retried with the same army (12:50); the second loss ended the run (25:47).
win_condition: Capture every enemy piece in each game and clear all five stages; in the video Tony beats both bosses and the run ends in stage 3 game 1.
